'''June 2001 Madrid tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Madrid, Spain on 2 June 2001. [[Heraclio Sanchez]] won it. It is known from Heraclio Sanchez's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2406">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-ithor-madrid-06-02-01d2406/ ithor-madrid-06-02-01], DeckTech (Heraclio "Morgoth" Sanchez, 4 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-ithor-madrid-06-02-01d2406/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Madrid, Spain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Heraclio Sanchez]]
